"use client" import { useId, useState, type ReactNode } from "react" import { Attachment, AttachmentAction, AttachmentActions, AttachmentContent, AttachmentGroup, AttachmentMedia, AttachmentTitle, } from "@/components/ui/attachment" import { Field, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field" import { InputGroup, InputGroupAddon, InputGroupButton, InputGroupText, InputGroupTextarea, } from "@/components/ui/input-group" import { IconPlaceholder } from "@/app/(create)/components/icon-placeholder" const ICON_SHEET = ( ) const ICON_IMAGE = ( ) const ICON_TEXT = ( ) const ICON_CODE = ( ) const ICON_REMOVE = ( ) const ICON_ATTACH = ( ) const ICON_SEND = ( ) type Source = { id: string name: string icon: ReactNode } // Icons ride in the data as ready made nodes rather than component // references. The shadcn CLI rewrites IconPlaceholder props where it finds // them, so the five names have to sit in the source as plain literals. const FILES: Source[] = [ { id: "churn", name: "churn-drivers.csv", icon: ICON_SHEET }, { id: "pricing", name: "pricing-tiers-v4.xlsx", icon: ICON_SHEET }, { id: "latency", name: "checkout-latency.png", icon: ICON_IMAGE }, { id: "limits", name: "rate-limits.md", icon: ICON_TEXT }, { id: "trace", name: "stack-trace-2041.log", icon: ICON_CODE }, { id: "invoice", name: "invoice-3182.pdf", icon: ICON_TEXT }, ] export function Pattern() { // useId rather than a fixed string, so the label and the textarea stay // paired even when two copies of this composer share one page. const id = useId() const [attachedIds, setAttachedIds] = useState([ "churn", "pricing", "latency", ]) // Both lists are derived during render rather than stored. A second piece of // state for "the next file" would only have to be kept in step with the // first, and the paperclip already knows everything it needs from the ids. const attached = FILES.filter((file) => attachedIds.includes(file.id)) const next = FILES.find((file) => !attachedIds.includes(file.id)) // The tray renders only when it holds something. An empty block-start addon // still draws its own padding, which would leave a dead band above the // textarea the moment the last chip is removed. const hasTray = attached.length > 0 // One sentence, rendered twice. The visible copy sits in the composer // chrome, which nothing announces, so a live region repeats it below and // makes each removal audible. const summary = `${attached.length} of ${FILES.length} attached` return (
event.preventDefault()}> Message the assistant {hasTray ? ( {/* * AttachmentGroup forces its children to flex-none and scrolls * them, so the fourth and fifth chips slide sideways instead of * adding a second row and shoving the transcript off screen. */} {attached.map((file) => ( {file.icon} {file.name} {/* * type="button" is spelled out because this composer is * a real form, and a button with no explicit type * submits it. */} setAttachedIds((current) => current.filter((value) => value !== file.id) ) } > {ICON_REMOVE} ))} ) : null} {/* * The textarea grows with the draft and stops at a cap, so a long * message scrolls inside the box instead of pushing the tray off * the top. */} {/* * Once the pool runs dry the paperclip is disabled rather than * removed: a control that vanishes reflows the row and explains * nothing. */} { if (next) { setAttachedIds((current) => [...current, next.id]) } }} > {ICON_ATTACH} {summary} {ICON_SEND} Send
